subject: Proverbs 1 opens today

blocks.text: Here is what today looks like.
Answer the questions, and see what everyone else noticed.
Tomorrow is Proverbs 2. The day after that, Proverbs 3.
And we keep going, one chapter a day, to the end of October.
By then you will have read every chapter of Proverbs.
But that is not really the point.
The point is that you spent a month on purpose, looking for God's wisdom.
"If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures; then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God."
Free. No Zoom. No meetings. Your own schedule.
And if you open this a few days late, you are not too late. Every day stays open, so you can start now and catch up.
Don't spend another year saving single verses from Proverbs. Spend October actually studying it.

closing: It is completely free, and it starts today.
